newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FOODLAND Q4 SALES UP 8.7 PCT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FOODLAND Q4 SALES UP 8.7 PCT.

text.p: Grocery wholesaler and retailer Foodland Associated Ltd said on Thursday its sales in its fourth quarter, the 13 weeks to August 3, rose 8.7 percent to A$980.87 million.
Sales for the 53 weeks to August 3 rose 1.7 percent to A$3.74 billion from A$3.68 billion in the 52 weeks to July 28, 1996.

Total sales on a comparable like-for-like basis rose 3.0 percent for the fourth quarter to A$893.61 million, while year sales rose 1.7 percent to A$3.53 billion. This comparison also adjusts for the extra week in 1996/97.
Foodland said its Western Australian wholesale sales rose 2.7 percent in the quarter on a comparable basis.

"This growth exceeds the previous quarter's rise by one percent and has resulted from the continued sales improvement of the internal franchise groups, Dewsons, Rules, Supa Valu and Foodland," Foodland said.
It said its own retail chain increased sales for the quarter by 9.6 percent on a comparable basis, following increases of over nine percent for the preceding two quarters.
Foodland's Farmer Deka Ltd in New Zealand increased sales on a comparable basis by 6.7 percent during the quarter. "Farmers sales performance is ahead of expectations," the company said.
